svg.title: A 12K server maximum doubles short-turn capacity and preserves the reference boundary
svg.desc: Grouped bars compare maximum passing concurrency when server maximum context is Qwen3.8's native 262K tokens and when it is 12K tokens. The 2K-input 512-output workload rises from eleven to twenty-two, while the 8K-input 1K-output workload stays at seven.
